blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — A firefight erupted in Balabagan, Lanao del Sur, around noon on Sunday, Nov. 22, involving two warring Moro clans and leaving one person injured, police said. Capt. Steffi Salanguit, spokesperson for the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), said the rido, or clan feud, involved the Sampiano and Karim families, both from Balabagan. She identified the wounded as Adnan Maute, 26, a resident of Barangay Poblacion and a member of the Sampiano family.
